all100AssignmentsProof.type: Independent mathematical invariant, not a simulation
all100AssignmentsProof.invariant: R_i = P XOR XOR(a_2..a_(i-1)) = XOR(b_i..b_n), for i>=2
all100AssignmentsProof.deduction: a_i = R_i XOR XOR(b_(i+1)..b_n) = b_i; update R_(i+1)=R_i XOR a_i.
all100AssignmentsProof.optimality: Keep all hats except b_1 fixed and flip b_1. Person 1 has the same observations and therefore utters the same word in both assignments, so cannot be correct in both. Thus no legal strategy guarantees n correct; the protocol guarantees n-1.
